table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Manufacturer = (SELECT M.Name FROM Manufacturer M WHERE M.ManfCode = :ai_manfcode),
	invcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date       = dbo.saleledger.Postdate,    
	doctype 	= Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	invtotal = dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode),
	ManfSaleTotal = 
			ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) * (1 - dbo.saleledger.DiscPerc * 0.01)
			FROM SaleDetail D, Item I
			WHERE D.SaleInvCode=dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode AND D.ICode = I.ICode AND I.ManfCode = :ai_manfcode), 0),
	dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	dbo.accounts.name,
	accountfor=dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	impactinventory=dbo.saleledger.impactinventory
 
FROM 	
	dbo.saleledger, dbo.accounts, dbo.users  

WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.Postdate between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)  And
	( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) ) and  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) and  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )
